version.description: Configuration format version. The only supported value is 1.

ForwardedHeader.description: Header from which a trusted reverse proxy's client address is read.

gravatar_enabled.description:
Show Gravatar images for users without an OIDC picture. Browsers then
send a hash of the configured email address to gravatar.com.

origin.description: Public HTTPS origin where browsers access Crabinet.

database_path.description: SQLite file. Relative paths are resolved from the configuration directory.

header_read_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to send a complete request head, also bounding keep-alive idle time.

listen.description: TCP socket address on which the HTTP server listens.

login_attempts_per_minute.description: Login attempts allowed per normalized username and source address each minute.

login_attempts_per_source_per_minute.description:
Password sign-in attempts allowed from one source address each minute,
counted across all usernames and checked before any password hashing.
IPv6 sources are grouped by /64.

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneously open client connections; new connections above it are closed.

max_image_decode_memory.description:
Total memory, for example "256 MiB", that image thumbnail decodes may
reserve at once, at most "4 GiB". Each decode reserves its estimated
peak first; an image whose estimate exceeds the whole budget is not
thumbnailed.

max_preview_size.description: Largest text, code, Markdown, HTML, or SVG file previewed whole, for example "2 MiB"; a larger one previews only its first 64 KiB and 1,000 lines. Streamed images, PDF, audio, and video are not bound by it.

max_sessions_per_user.description: Maximum simultaneously active sessions retained for one user.

max_sessions_total.description: Maximum simultaneously active sessions retained across all users.

max_thumbnail_cache_size.description:
Maximum total size of cached thumbnails, for example "256 MiB", at most
"64 GiB". The oldest entries are evicted beyond it; "0 B" disables the
cache.

max_upload_size.description: Maximum request upload size, for example "100 MiB".

session_secret_file.description: File containing 32 to 4096 random bytes. Its contents are never printed.

thumbnail_cache_path.description:
Directory for cached thumbnails, created with owner-only permissions.
Relative paths are resolved from the configuration directory. Defaults
to `thumbnails` next to `database_path`.

trash_retention_days.description: Number of days before an item in Trash is eligible for permanent removal.

trusted_proxies.description:
Reverse proxy addresses or CIDR ranges, such as "192.0.2.10" or
"2001:db8::/64", whose `trusted_proxy_header` names the client. Empty,
the default, ignores forwarding headers and uses the TCP peer.

trusted_proxy_header.description: Forwarding header a trusted proxy sets to name the client.

id.description: Stable identifier used in URLs and grants.

name.description: User-facing label. It may change without changing the share's identity or URLs.

path.description: Absolute directory path. The root itself must not be a symbolic link.

read_only.description: If true, every grant on this share is effectively read-only.

disabled.description: Disabled users cannot log in and their existing sessions are rejected.

email.description: Email returned as a verified claim by the configured OIDC provider.

oidc_subject.description:
Optional OIDC `sub` claim this user's ID token must carry in addition
to the verified email. Requires `email`.

password_hash.description: An Argon2id PHC string produced by `crabinet hash-password`.
